meta.description: Machine-readable canonical-vs-empirical status for the Q_beta c_k precision ladder and the m_p d_k brane-tower. The markdown twin is the human-readable authority; this JSON is the dashboard/validator-readable mirror. Tiers and wiring MUST agree between the two.

tiers.canonical: derived to compute precision (Taylor-exact) AND anchor-stable
tiers.empirical_near_match: reproduces empirical value at one anchor; not anchor-stable
tiers.artifact: a normalisation/extraction artifact, not a coefficient

symbols.c_k_of_n: exponents in F_n(z) = prod (1 - q^-k z)^{-c_k(n)} — DIFFERENT object
symbols.c_k_d_k_pair: eigenvalue-factor pair in chi_sym(beta) = prod (c_k q + d_k) — DIFFERENT object
symbols.d_k_differential: chain-complex differential d_{k+1} . d_k = 0 — UNRELATED homological d

qbeta_ck_ladder.formula: Q_beta = Q_base * prod_k (1 + c_k * u^k), u = b * hbar_q^2

rungs.note: Proton-anchor near-match; REFUTED as real-q fibre element (swings -2.375% to muon; dc_3/dq ~ 3.84e6). Locked behind conditional QbetaC3StructuralFormClass (3b-cond), not a derivation. CORRECTED 2026-08-29 (qou-kt8o): this note read '-2.88%' and '4.6e6'. Both are the pre-#1422 SUPERSEDED muon c_3 = -2.0097; live was -2.02020024, and the .md twin ck-dk-canonical-registry.md SS3 absorbed the correction on 2026-08-25 (PR #5765) while this JSON did not. The REFUTED verdict is unaffected -- 3.84e6 is just as impossible for a smooth real f as 4.6e6; only the magnitudes were wrong. RE-CORRECTED 2026-08-31 (qou-cds1 / qou-t39x): -2.02020024 is itself the CODATA-2018 extraction, superseded when fca08de7d2 (2026-08-22) moved the muon pin to CODATA 2022. Live muon c_3 = -2.01986031 and the swing is -2.391%, not -2.375%. dc_3/dq is UNCHANGED at 3.84e6 -- it is anchor-layer invariant (secant 3838405.894 at the 2018 pin vs 3838405.878 at the 2022 pin, identical to 8 digits), because both legs move together. AND THE HONEST ERROR BAR, WHICH THIS ROW NEVER CARRIED: propagated through the CAL inputs at CODATA-2022 published uncertainties, c_3(muon) = -2.0199 +- 1.26, dominated by Q_beta alone (0.78 ppm x 1/u^3 = 1.6e6). Nine significant figures are quoted for a quantity the calibration inputs support to 0.2 of one. What IS resolved is the cross-anchor swing: Q_beta and m_e are common mode and cancel in the difference, leaving -0.0494823 +- 0.0052, i.e. 9.5 sigma. So the REFUTED verdict rests on the one quantity here that survives its own error bar; no absolute c_3 digit past the first does.

CODATA-residual fit; separately flagged as a normalisation artifact (2026-06-04). Mechanically confirmed 2026-07-11 (P4 entropy audit, PR #3536, computations/probes/qbeta-ck-basis-constrained-pslq.witness.json): with c_3 extracted exactly against the same Q reference, c_4 reproduces as identically 0 — the quoted -0.972 is the truncation residual of a rounded c_3, zero independent empirical content. The extraction chain sigma_R/u^k leaves ZERO reliable digits at k>=4; kernel tests at k>=4 need canonical rungs (H_4 Hoefsmit c_4^even build, bean 8we6), never extracted ones.

Stays empirical, no production wire. §8 flip-flop guard applies.
